title: What Makes Recurrence Generalize Across Lengths?
abstract: arXiv:2611.29171v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-step reasoning requires models to preserve and update intermediate information as computation unfolds. State tracking captures this fundamental requirement, but models that succeed within a fixed range of state transitions may not generalize when substantially more updates are required. Recurrent Transformers offer a natural mechanism for addressing this challenge by repeatedly applying shared Transformer blocks, allowing computation to scale with problem length. We study when such recurrent computation generalizes beyond the training range in a controlled state-tracking task, varying operation representation, positional encoding, and recurrent capacity. We find that recurrence alone is insufficient: multi-token template representations and absolute positional encoding can severely limit extrapolation, whereas atomic operation representations enable substantially stronger length generalization. translated_title: 《什么使循环结构能够跨长度泛化？》
translated_abstract: 多步推理要求模型在计算展开的过程中保存并更新中间信息。状态追踪正是对这一基本需求的刻画，但在固定范围的状态转移内表现良好的模型，在需要远超训练范围的更多更新时可能无法泛化。循环Transformer通过反复应用共享的Transformer块，为应对这一挑战提供了天然的机制，使计算能够随问题长度而扩展。我们在一个受控的状态追踪任务中研究这种循环计算何时能够泛化到训练范围之外，并变化了操作表示、位置编码和循环容量等因素。我们发现，仅有循环机制是不够的：多token模板表示和绝对位置编码会严重限制外推能力，而原子化的操作表示则能带来显著更强的长度泛化。位置结构的影响……
tldr: 该研究发现，循环Transformer要实现超出训练长度的泛化，仅有循环机制并不足够——原子化（单token）的操作表示是关键，而多token模板表示和绝对位置编码会严重限制长度外推能力。
